description: Ex RAF T.4 WT476 rebuilt by BAC as T Mk.64 (c/n EEP71416), delivered February 1971; flew 37 sorties in the 1982 war, the most of any Argentine Canberra; retired 5 April 2000 and displayed near the main gate, visible from Av. Jorge Newbery. Photographed November 2014.
aliases: Canberra B62; Canberra T64; WT476; c/n 71416
museum_name: II Brigada Aérea Paraná Historic Park

description: Last IA-50 built (c/n 34, completed January 1975), retired 1999 and set up as gate guardian of the brigade in 2000. Photographed November 2014.
aliases: IA50; Guaraní; G-II; GII; c/n 34; IA-50
museum_name: II Brigada Aérea Paraná Historic Park

description: IA-35 c/n 22, served with II Brigada from 1963 to 1971, then instructional airframe of the brigade technical school until 1994; displayed on the base as a monument. Some sources (aeron-aves) give this airframe as A-317 c/n 38 — conflict noted; Gaceta Aeronáutica (Mustone) identifies it as A-320 c/n 22. Photographed November 2014 and July 2022.
museum_name: II Brigada Aérea Paraná Historic Park

description: Second airframe to carry T-110, fitted with wings from F-31; conserved inside the brigade (photographed November 2016 by F. Rovira). Not the prototype c/n 00 at Tancacha.
